measurement_contract.workload: causal 15-output recurrent policy + sampled trajectory + reward/score backward + Adam update

measurement_contract.cpu_memory: 2 ms process-RSS peak sampler in an isolated worker
measurement_contract.cuda_memory: torch max allocated/reserved bytes including backward graph

summary.claim_boundary: The decision covers one current-host forward/backward/Adam-update kernel. It does not prove optimization convergence, seed robustness, lifetime ranking, physical cutoff convergence, device calibration, or FPGA timing.
